If the market had priced a large mark, the stock would not have printed a 12-month low of $3.00 on 16 Oct, three weeks after the verdict. Against that, it rose about 26% off that low into the seal, which may be partly anticipation. The finding is capped because the gain is non-cash, the bar is snippet_only and stale, Apple's post-quarter JMOL gives skeptics a ready reason to discount the mark, and Burford's own release warns 'very few large patent verdicts survive the post-verdict process intact'.
